post.description:
Cancels a live trade whose entry is still waiting (M11.1-FR-21). Alpaca is
asked, then the order is read again: it may have filled as the cancel crossed.

ApprovalProblem.title: ApprovalProblem
ApprovalProblem.description: Why a decision was refused. Nothing is recorded and no order is placed.

AttemptRow.title: AttemptRow
AttemptRow.description: Section 6: one trader attempt and what the risk manager did with it.

DebateNarrative.title: DebateNarrative
DebateNarrative.description:
The debate in plain language (M11.1-FR-4): a paragraph per round, then how it
led to the trader's decision.

DebateTurnView.title: DebateTurnView
DebateTurnView.description: One debate turn as the live report keeps it (M11.1-FR-8).

OrderPreview.title: OrderPreview
OrderPreview.description:
The order the chosen mode would place, priced from the live price, with
nothing placed (M11.1-FR-10). Every number is `None` when it can't be priced
(no price for a market order, or exits that can't hold); `warnings` say why.

OrderPreviewBody.title: OrderPreviewBody
OrderPreviewBody.description: What the order box asks the preview to price (M11.1-FR-10).

Problem.title: Problem
Problem.description:
A refusal: a stable `code` and a message. No stack trace, key or config
snapshot ever appears in one (M8-FR-19). Approval refusals send the richer
`ApprovalProblem` (both prices, the largest share count that fits).

SizedOrder.title: SizedOrder
SizedOrder.description:
Stage A's sized order (M4-FR-7, FR-8): shares, exits, and which of the
four limits set the size, so the report can show all four (M5).

pnl.title: Pnl
pnl.description: (exit - entry) x shares, once closed or marked at the window end.

Trade.title: Trade
Trade.description: One bracket order's life in a broker (M6 specs-plan sec5).

pnl.title: Pnl
pnl.description: (exit - entry) x shares, once closed or marked at the window end.

TradeOut.title: TradeOut
TradeOut.description: A live or simulated trade with the request it belongs to.
